images.credit: NASA / Chandra X-ray Center (SAO/CXC); Chandra Data Archive; CDS HiPS2FITS
images.bands: RGB soft / medium / hard bands; exact energy boundaries not specified in retrieved HiPS metadata.
images.description: Observed Chandra public X-ray image. Resolved diffuse cluster emission and point sources are visible. Photon-counting noise remains. This is X-ray emission, not a pure gas-density or temperature map; no point-source removal or spectral gas separation applied.
images.projection: ICRS TAN; north up, east left; 512×512; 0.166750 degree square footprint
images.processing: Only documented CDS HiPS2FITS reprojection; source color/contrast retained. No smoothing or synthetic spatial content introduced.
images.reuse: Public archive data; retain observatory/archive and HiPS service credits. No explicit license string in retrieved original HiPS properties.

images.credit: ESA / SSC XMM-Newton; Galhecos-Team (Strasbourg); L. Michel (Observatoire de Strasbourg); CDS HiPS2FITS
images.bands: Red 0.5–1 keV; green 1–2 keV; blue 2–4.5 keV.
images.description: Observed XMM-Newton PN color mosaic from 4XMM-DR12. Diffuse cluster emission and unresolved/point sources remain. X-ray emission image, not pure gas density. Lower native HiPS sampling than Chandra.
images.projection: ICRS TAN; north up, east left; 512×512; 0.166750 degree square footprint
images.processing: Only documented CDS HiPS2FITS reprojection; source color/contrast retained. No smoothing or synthetic spatial content introduced.
images.reuse: Public archive data; retain observatory/archive and HiPS service credits. No explicit license string in retrieved original HiPS properties.

comparisonCaveat: Includes hot intracluster plasma emission, point sources and background. CATS kappa is model-inferred projected total mass; optical is observed light. Neither X-ray intensity nor kappa directly images dark matter particles.
